name: VAANI (Vibrant Advocacy for Advancement and Nurturing of Indian Languages)
benefit:
- The scheme provides financial assistance up to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- per programme.
- The honorarium for experts is a maximum of ₹5,000/- per expert and per session.
- Financial assistance shall be reimbursed against actual expenses after the successful completion of the conference, seminar, or workshop and the submission of requisite documents.
- An advance of 50% of the sanctioned amount wi
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an AICTE-approved institute, including institutions offering Bachelor of Business Administration or Bachelor of Computer Applications programs. - The applicant must identify a co-coordinator who must be a faculty member with at least seven years of experience in teaching and research. - The applicant must ensure the academic background of the coordinator, co-coordinator, resource persons, and paper presenters is in conformity with the theme of the proposed event. - The applicant must ensure participants are strictly faculty members of approved institutions, research scholars, Master of Technology scholars, research fellows, or working professionals from the industry. - The applicant must ensure the event is conducted in one of the twenty-two specified Indian languages, such as Assamese, Bengali, Bodo, Dogri, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Santhali, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu, or Urdu. - The applicant must limit their application to receive the grant to once in a year.
